malgun.label: 맑은 고딕 지정
malgun.notes: Measurement substitute for 맑은 고딕 (Malgun Gothic 6.69; not redistributable, not installable on the Linux server). Why: no free font has Malgun's advances (Hangul 1.000 em for all 11,172 syllables, space 0.3516 em, tabular digits 0.5508/0.5796 em); the best plain OFL fonts are 2-13% narrower on a 77-line Korean business corpus (Gothic A1 Bold -2.2%, NanumGothic Regular -4.1%, Noto Sans KR -7.6%, Pretendard -12.3%), so "PoC Malgun Substitute" in theme/fonts-malgun.css combines UNMODIFIED OFL files by unicode-range, each face with its own size-adjust (Regular / Bold): Gothic A1 2.50 fonts/GothicA1-*.ttf for Hangul syllables 104.0650% / 100.3922% (exact) and for jamo, CJK symbols, fullwidth and everything else 100% (Malgun and Gothic A1 are both 1.000 em there); Selawik 1.01 fonts/selawk.ttf, selawkb.ttf (Microsoft's OFL Segoe UI metric-compatible font; Malgun's Latin = Segoe UI x1.0216) for Latin and punctuation 101.7949% / 99.3958% (corpus fit), digits 102.1739% / 100.7640% (exact) and space + NBSP 128.3422% / 127.4336% (exact); Noto Sans KR 2.004 variable fonts/NotoSansKR-VF.ttf for Hanja 100% (exact). Every face also sets ascent/descent/line-gap overrides so the effective CSS line metrics equal Malgun's hhea/win metrics (2229/495/0 per 2048 = 1.0884/0.2417/0 em). measureFile = the Gothic A1 file of that weight (the Hangul carrier): any server-side width computation must apply the per-range factors above; better use Chromium's layout. Measured error: Chromium 149 launched with --font-render-hinting=none, all corpus lines at 13-100 px, substitute vs REAL Malgun Gothic (read in place from C:\Windows\Fonts, never copied): per-line width ratio mean 0.999-1.001, sd 0.26%; slack (Malgun/substitute) p99 1.003 Regular / 1.009 Bold, max 1.006 / 1.019 (Latin-heavy Bold line); line boxes and baselines pixel-identical. Builder slack: widen wrapped (wrap=true) text boxes by 2% (factor 1.02; it also covers Malgun's own kern table, <=1.0%). The extractor must launch Chromium with --font-render-hinting=none: default hinting rounds every glyph advance to whole CSS px at any DSF (errors of -6.6%..+4.2% per run) and makes Malgun's line boxes hinted/VDMX-dependent. Details: docs/research/fonts.md.
